report.question:
make-checkpoint-gate-durable, task 8.1 (design D11, D7 row 'ContainerEnvironments.roundEnvironment()') is blocked by the compile-time parameter-count gate.

Done this round and ticked (verified): 7.3 CurrentRound/ClosedRound/RoundToken in app/port/git, 7.4 persistence from closed(), 7.5 decisions/ removed in the three outcome-clearing commits (ConsumedRequestRemoval), 7.6 E2E through --decision (ContainerModeResumeE2ESpec 2/2, SandboxLifecycleZombieE2ESpec 1/1), 4.3, 7.7 gates (DecisionPathOwnerSpec, CurrentRoundWriterSpec, RoundTokenIdentitySpec), 7.8 javadoc, 4.7 ContainerResumePreparation. Details: temporary-docs/gnomish/github-oinsio-gnomish-factory-83/implement.md.

Blocker: ContainerEnvironments.forTask (sandbox/docker/.../ContainerEnvironments.java:60-67) already takes 7 parameters (baseKey, link, sandbox, timing, allowlist, guardConfigRoot, ownership). Adding the Supplier<DenialRestoration> that 8.1 and D11 require fails compileJava: '[ParameterCountLimit] 8 parameters; the limit is 7'. The design does not say how to absorb the eighth parameter.

Second finding (lock-scope.md): roundEnvironment()'s only caller, EnvironmentLease.environmentFor (EnvironmentLease.java:60), is synchronized, and the same monitor guards current()/currentIfLeased() (field reads). The supplier's git tip read would run under it. The monitor already spans docker subprocesses (harvest/dispose/materialize), so this widens a pre-existing violation; the change's artifacts do not classify it. My recommendation: accept it for this change and record it in D11 as pre-existing debt for a follow-up change; do not split the lease in this change.

Also: 8.1 cannot compile apart from 8.2's port deletion (SandboxRunSupport.restoreDenials() is abstract), so I would do 8.1 and 8.2 in one step.

Side note: before this question was written, the decision file held a stray {"question": "Refactor or patch?"}. A fake-agent spec run probably wrote it because it inherited $GNOMISH_DECISION_FILE from this round (test isolation gap). It was overwritten.

How should the eighth input reach ContainerEnvironments? (A) Recommended: a parameter object over the box-build inputs (sandbox, timing, allowlist, guardConfigRoot, ownership), which recur in ContainerEnvironmentBuilder; forTask(baseKey, link, <box inputs>, supplier). This needs a D7 row answering the three ADR 0010 / process-invariants tests. (B) An immutable wither, forTask(...).offering(supplier), that returns a new instance built with the supplier. This deviates from the task text 'at construction (forTask(...))'. (C) The first production @ParameterLimitExemption on forTask, with its reason. (D) Put the supplier on BoxGitLink. Not recommended: three box roles share BoxGitLink, and judge/verify boxes need no restoration.

Tasks 4.4-4.6, §5 and §6 are untouched; I stopped as the stage rules require. 6.2 appears already done by a human: crash-consistency.md has items 12 and 13. Please answer for 8.1 and confirm whether to tick 6.2.
options: A: parameter object over the box-build inputs; record lock widening as pre-existing debt in D11; do 8.1+8.2 together
B: immutable wither forTask(...).offering(supplier); lock widening recorded as debt
C: @ParameterLimitExemption on forTask with a reason; lock widening recorded as debt
Other: see comment (e.g. also split the EnvironmentLease lock in this change)
